'''Geordi Hans''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] who worked on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was employed by [[Unut Poll]], the owner of [[Spaceport Speeders/Legends|Spaceport Speeders]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], and was charged with keeping the products in top condition. Along with friends [[Jeff Pill]] and [[Franklin Scott]], he was a member of a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|gang]] called the [[Farns]].<ref name="GG7" />
